topic: Maguire et al. (2000, 2006, 2011): London Taxi Drivers' 'The Knowledge' & Posterior Hippocampal Remodeling (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Maguire & Woollett's 4-year prospective MRI tracking of 79 trainees proves Day-1 hippocampi are identical and posterior gray matter expands exclusively in the 39 trainees who qualify.
